thread:
incident-bot: Pager — P1: inference-ap-west1: GPU pool exhausted; autoscaler reporting FailedAttach/quotahit. Queue length > 4k, 15% error rate. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/gpu-quota
oncall-ops: Ack — I'm oncall. Triage in progress.
sre-alex: I'm seeing repeated attach denies from GCP: "quotaExceeded for accelerators" in ap-west1 zones. Kube autoscaler logs show backoff.
eng-runtime-maya: Autoscaler shows FailedAttach entries and exponential retries. Example: `failed to attach accelerator: quotaExceeded` — no successful new nodes.
infra-jordan: Checked GCP console: project redwood-prod-apwest1 near hard GPU limit for requested machine type. No available accelerators in ap-west1-a/b/c. Opening support case now.
infra-jordan: GCP case opened: 012345678901 — contacting account team.
customer-success-lee: Impact: Hosted inference 429/503 spike for ap-west1 customers. Telemetry: 15% 429s on inference routes, some sessions timing out (>30s). Notifying impacted accounts.
oncall-ops: Mitigations we can do now: 1) Shift traffic to fallback region ap-southeast1, 2) Throttle non-critical background jobs, 3) Provision temporary smaller GPU types if quota allows. Starting traffic reroute.
oncall-ops: Patching route: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap routing --patch '{"data":{"ap-west1.svc.weight":"0.5"}}'` — pushing 50% traffic to ap-southeast1.
sre-alex: Patch accepted. Observed queue drop from ~4200 -> ~2300 in 2 minutes. Error rate reduced to ~8%.
eng-runtime-maya: Recommend also enabling a smaller-instance pool (T4) in ap-west1 if we have spare quota in other projects and can attach quickly. Can add to cluster as a node group.
infra-jordan: I can spin up a temporary compute project and attach nodes there; will update if GCP approves cross-project quota use. Executing `gcloud compute instances create ... --accelerator type=nvidia-t4,count=1` now.
incident-bot: Update scheduled: GCP support ETA ~45m. Auto-notify on case status.
customer-success-lee: CS is messaging acct-alpha and acct-beta (active sessions) with status and mitigation. Will follow up when we have ETA.
oncall-ops: Handoff note for next oncall: routing is at 50/50 ap-west1/ap-southeast1, temp T4 pool provisioning in progress, GCP case 012345678901 open, CS notified. Monitor queue and error rate; escalate to infra if attach-deny persists.
sre-alex: Logs snippet: ```json
{"time":"2026-03-17T12:01:02Z","level":"error","msg":"FailedAttach","err":"quotaExceeded","zone":"ap-west1-a"}
```
eng-runtime-maya: Adding a temporary canary cap on fallback to avoid overloading ap-southeast1 — max migration 60% until we validate capacity. Also adding an alert for attach-deny burst > 5/min.
infra-jordan: Temporary T4 pool created and registered to cluster: added 12 nodes. Autoscaler accepted nodes; draining queue now. Queue ~800, error rate ~2%.
oncall-ops: Severity -> P2. Continuing to monitor for 2h post-closure. Will start postmortem actions.
sre-alex: Postmortem action items: 1) Request 20% GPU quota increase in ap-west1, 2) Automate cross-region fallback routing, 3) Load test autoscaler under quota-starvation scenarios. I'll open tracking tickets.
incident-bot: Incident update: severity reduced to P2 at 2026-03-17T12:12Z. Next update scheduled in 30m."
